plain: A tensor can be assembled from small rules, not just displayed as a table. Each piece says: read one part of the input, multiply by a coefficient, then send the result along a chosen direction. Adding all pieces gives the whole action.
張量不只可以排成表，也能拆成幾條小規則：先讀出輸入的一部分，乘上一個係數，再沿指定方向送出。把每條規則的結果加起來，就拼回完整的作用。
analogy: Think of a sorting station. A reader measures how much arrives along one direction; a belt sends that amount along another. The output arrows e₁,e₂ are the basis; the readers ε¹,ε² are the dual basis. Each reader returns 1 on its matching basis arrow and 0 on the other.
想像一個分送站：讀尺先量出輸入在某個方向有多少，輸送帶再把份量送往另一個方向。送出的箭頭 e₁、e₂ 是基底；讀取用的 ε¹、ε² 是對偶基底。每把讀尺讀自己的基底箭頭會得到 1，讀另一支會得到 0。
precise: A coefficient Tⁱⱼ weights the rule eᵢ ⊗ εʲ: read with εʲ, then output along eᵢ. The ⊗ sign joins those two jobs. The type (1,1) counts one output-direction slot and one input-reader slot; this tensor takes a vector and returns a vector. Turning the measuring basis changes the readers and coefficients together, so the same physical input still gives the same physical output.
係數 Tⁱⱼ 替小規則 eᵢ ⊗ εʲ 加上份量；⊗ 把「用 εʲ 讀取」與「沿 eᵢ 送出」接起來。(1,1) 表示一個輸出方向位置、一個輸入讀尺位置；這個張量吃進向量、吐出向量。轉動量測基底時，讀尺與係數一起改寫，同一個實際輸入仍得到同一個實際輸出。
example: At 0°, use input v=(1,2). The four pieces contribute (2,0), (2,0), (0,0), (0,6), adding to (4,6). Select 90°: the coefficients and individual pieces change, but the final arrow stays at (4,6).
在 0° 時，輸入 v=(1,2)。四片分別送出 (2,0)、(2,0)、(0,0)、(0,6)，合起來是 (4,6)。按 90°：係數和各片的拆法變了，但最後的箭頭仍指向 (4,6)。
legend: Here i chooses an output arrow, j an input reader; Σ adds all four rules. The reader-basis pairing εʲ(eᵢ)=δʲᵢ means “1 for a match, 0 otherwise”, not a metric assumption.
i 選送出的箭頭，j 選讀取用的尺；Σ 把四條規則加起來。εʲ(eᵢ)=δʲᵢ 表示「配對為 1，否則為 0」，不是對長度或垂直性的假設。
parts: The amounts in the chosen basis.
選定基底下，每片小規則的份量。
指定送出方向，以及怎麼讀取輸入。
Change the description while preserving the action.
換描述方式，保留同一個作用。
Which input and output slots? Some tensors have extra symmetries.
有哪些輸入、輸出位置？部分張量另有對稱條件。
Measures lengths and angles; a nondegenerate metric also converts vectors and covectors.
量長度、角度；非退化度規也能轉換向量與協向量。
Compares tensors at different points and defines covariant differentiation.
比較不同位置的張量，並定義協變微分。
note: A tensor needs neither a metric nor a connection just to exist. Add them when the problem asks for measurement or comparison across locations.
張量的存在本身不要求度規或聯絡；要量長度，或跨位置比較、做協變微分時，再加上相應結構。
